description: A Perl script for extracting and parsing target, device, architecture, and kernel information from build system makefiles, with command-line interface for querying this data.

methods.name: parse_targetinfo
methods.description: Parses target information from makefile output, populating targets, architectures, and kernels hashes.

methods.name: parse_devices
methods.description: Parses device information from makefile output, populating devices hash.

methods.name: get_targetinfo
methods.description: Iterates over target makefiles to gather target, subtarget, and feature data.

methods.name: get_devices
methods.description: Retrieves device info for a specified target/subtarget.
